en: A color postcard view of a medieval stone tower rising above a high defensive wall with arches. A small red flag flies on top of the cylindrical tower. In front of the wall is a park-like path with grass, trees, and many pedestrians walking. To the right of the tower stands a light-colored building with a red/orange roof, likely part of a larger historic complex. The sky is bright blue with scattered clouds and there is no visible printed text on the image side.
